license.notes: MIT preserved unchanged from the upstream repository; no code was relicensed in standardization.

upstreamRuntime.contract: The only kernel import in this plugin's own modules. Called lazily for attribution headers; any failure degrades to a static fallback User-Agent. No kernel version is pinned. The vendored channel pack below is the one deliberate exception, and it is not this plugin's code.
upstreamRuntime.verifiedBy: scripts/catalog-test.mjs (adapter isolation gate, which exempts vendor/)

vendoredChannelPack.contract: A third-party dsh plugin adapted locally and bundled into one file by scripts/build-channel-pack.mjs. It provides ten enabled account channels (LobsterAI, Qoder, Qoder CN, TRAE, Cline, Loomy, Raccoon, MiniMax, ZCode, Gemini); the optional OpenCode account integration is disabled in this host and therefore imports the kernel itself; that import is upstream's design, not this plugin's seam. Mounted on its own fiber: a composition without credentials/commands/llm loses the channels and keeps the free lane. Credentials it obtains go to the host credential store, never to this plugin's files or to the browser.
vendoredChannelPack.provenanceNotes: vendor/channel-pack/NOTICE.md records what was taken, what was left out (upstream's own browser half) and how to rebuild the bundle.

distribution.selfUpdate: default; in-app updater verifies feed/manifest.json SHA-256 digests before installing
distribution.managedInstallation: distribution=managed stands both channels down; the distributing pack owns update timing and bytes

integrity.normalization: LF-normalized bytes (.gitattributes * text=auto eol=lf), matching what a git blob serves

mojobox.notes: catalog/dsh-plugin.json is the catalog-ready 0.15 record. It is not added to the Mojobox catalog repository by this change, and no artifact digest exists yet: the digest must be computed from the actual published tgz at release time and never invented. Mojobox integration is claimed only once that repository accepts the record.
